Explanation:  
The Predicted Answer states that William IV ruled from 26 June 1830 to 20 June 1837, which it calculates as 6 years and 359 days, specifically noting it as "just under seven years." The Ground Truth Answer specifies the duration as 6 years, 11 months, 25 days. Both answers are expressing the same period of time, as 11 months and 25 days is equivalent to 359 days. Thus, the substantive information from the Ground Truth Answer (the duration of reign) is present in the Predicted Answer, even if not worded exactly the same.

Decision: TRUE
